new_test.name: backend::profile_content::tests::actual_job_fence_cancellation_deadline_stop_and_fault_at_sqlite_precommit_roll_back
new_test.description: Actual PBKDF2/SQLite fixture and real fixed WorkerPool issue opaque context fences. A coordinator borrows Backend while the real context owner remains live; this is not a claim of the full Windows application job composition. A bounded fixture-only callback holds actual SQLite precommit when Health is AuthorityUpdating (mutations before COMMIT). Ticket cancel, real Instant deadline, pool request_stop, and a second physical worker panic each make the fence false. Each rejected finish leaves prior current unchanged and durable Begin.latest_publish_sequence intact. Known authority returns Healthy. Later cancellation after a successful commit does not undo current or durable Committed outcome.
